# AstryxAlertDialog { #anylumino.AstryxAlertDialog }

```python
AstryxAlertDialog(
    title,
    description,
    *,
    action_label,
    cancel_label='Cancel',
    open=True,
    inline=True,
    callbacks=None,
    **props,
)
```

Render an inline Astryx alert dialog for confirmations.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default    |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| title        | str                                                       | Dialog title linked to the alert for accessibility.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | _required_ |
| description  | str                                                       | Consequence or confirmation text linked to the alert for accessibility.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | _required_ |
| action_label | str                                                       | Primary action button label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | _required_ |
| cancel_label | str                                                       | Cancel button label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `'Cancel'` |
| open         | bool                                                      | Initial open state synchronized through ``value``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `True`     |
| inline       | bool                                                      | Whether dialog content renders inline instead of using native modal behavior.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `True`     |
| callbacks    | Iterable\[Callable\[\[ComponentWidget\], None\]\] \| None | Python callbacks invoked when the primary action is activated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `None`     |
| **props      | Any                                                       | JSON-safe AlertDialog props. Useful keys: actionVariant, isActionLoading, width, className, and style. anylumino manages title, description, actionLabel, cancelLabel, inline mode, open state, and confirm callbacks. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/AlertDialog>. | `{}`       |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

The wrapper defaults to inline rendering to avoid modal focus-management
conflicts inside Jupyter output areas. The primary action emits a click
message with ``action="confirm"``.
